rationale: The assistant respected the refusal, correctly ordered checks (unplug, hose behind machine, sink waste), used her evidence accurately and landed on the right likely cause (debris in the pump/filter path) while explicitly warning against ordering a pump. Safety advice was sound (isolate first, towels/tray, controlled draining, avoid repeated Drain/Spin). However it escalated to an engineer after only three exchanges without exploring the cheaper obvious alternatives the ground truth expected: asking whether a family member could clean the filter (her husband could), explaining LG's small capped emergency drain tube, or asking about coins in pockets. Minor stylistic repetition ('OE means...' opening every reply) and a stray character, but no fabrication, no unsafe steps and no unjustified part.
